title: Limoncello: Prefetchers for Scale
problem: In high-utilization data centers, traditional hardware prefetchers increase memory latency and decrease available bandwidth, degrading application performance. Prefetchers designed for isolated workloads become counterproductive when memory bandwidth is already saturated.
motivation: Memory bandwidth is a critical bottleneck in large-scale data centers, and optimizing prefetcher behavior for high-utilization conditions can unlock significant performance gains.
method: Limoncello dynamically monitors memory bandwidth utilization and adapts prefetcher configuration in software. It disables hardware prefetchers when bandwidth utilization is high to reduce contention and latency. When prefetchers are disabled, Limoncello deploys targeted software prefetching on critical library functions to maintain cache efficiency. The system operates entirely in software without hardware modifications.
key_novelty: Dynamic software-based prefetcher control that adapts to memory bandwidth utilization, disabling hardware prefetchers under high contention and substituting targeted software prefetching.
contributions: A software system for dynamic hardware prefetcher configuration based on real-time memory bandwidth utilization
Targeted software prefetching strategy for library functions as a replacement for disabled hardware prefetchers
Demonstration of 10% throughput improvement on Google's production fleet through intelligent prefetcher management
Evidence that software-only approaches can effectively optimize prefetching without hardware modifications

metrics.other: 15% memory latency reduction, minimal cache miss rate change
